_README: PROJECT ADAPTER. This is the ONLY file you must fill in per project. The generic agents/hooks read it. Leave a value as an empty string to mark a gate 'not configured' (it will be skipped, not failed).

modules.name: site
modules.description: HTML pages, CSS, and client-side JS for thesolidchain.com. Workers assigned to this module must not edit outside site/.

modules.name: assets
modules.description: Images, fonts, and media referenced by the site. Workers assigned to this module must not edit outside assets/.

modules.name: docs
modules.description: Project documentation. Workers assigned to this module must not edit outside docs/.

gates._note: Exact shell commands for this repo. Run from repo root. Empty string = skip.

worktree._note: Optional per-worktree lifecycle. `setup` runs right after an isolated implementer/reviewer worktree is created. Empty string = skip.

review._consensus_note: 'all' = every lens must approve; or an integer = that many approvals required.

budget._note: Opus to coordinate and review, Sonnet to build, Haiku to explore. Every +1 max_parallel_workers multiplies token burn AND your review load.
